title: Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance: Issue Ages and Specified Amount Limits
content:
## New business limits — Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance

The Ashgrove CareAssure tiers of Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance are issued only to insureds whose issue age lies between the lowest and highest issue age of the tier, both ages included, and only for a specified amount between the tier's smallest and largest specified amount on one policy, both amounts included. Issue age is the insured's age last birthday on the issue date. Every tier is underwritten on full medical underwriting with a cognitive screen.

| Tier | Lowest issue age | Highest issue age | Smallest specified amount | Largest specified amount on one policy | Policy loans |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 40 | 79 | $50000 | $1000000 | Not offered |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 40 | 79 | $50000 | $1000000 | Not offered |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 40 | 79 | $50000 | $1000000 | Not offered |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 40 | 77 | $50000 | $1000000 | Not offered |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 40 | 75 | $50000 | $1000000 | Not offered |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 40 | 70 | $100000 | $500000 | Not offered |

### Points of judgement

- **Age boundaries.** An insured aged 79 last birthday on the issue date is within the issue ages of the Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year, 3-Year and 4-Year; an insured aged 80 is outside them. For the Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year the highest issue age is 77, for the 6-Year 75 and for the Lifetime 70. An insured aged 39 is below the lowest issue age of every tier.
- **Amount boundaries.** A specified amount of exactly $50000 is within the limits of the five fixed-period tiers; the Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime requires at least $100000 and accepts no more than $500000 on one policy.
- **Policy loans.** No tier of Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance offers policy loans.

### Worked cases (hypothetical applicants)

| Applicant | Tier applied for | Issue age | Specified amount | Within the tier's limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 75 | $250000 | Yes |
| B | Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 76 | $250000 | No — above the highest issue age |
| C | Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 62 | $600000 | No — above the largest specified amount on one policy |
| D | Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 62 | $100000 | Yes |
